As Apple (AAPL) Stock Rose, Shareholder Evanson Asset Management Has Cut Stake by $4.17 Million; Essex Investment Management Co Increased Its Holding in Harvard Bioscience (HBIO) by $334,077 
March 12, 2018 - By Vivian Currie 
Essex Investment Management Co Llc increased its stake in Harvard Bioscience Inc (HBIO) by 25.93% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Essex Investment Management Co Llc bought 111,359 shares as the company’s stock declined 22.58% while stock markets rallied. The hedge fund held 540,819 shares of the capital goods company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $2.03M, up from 429,460 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Essex Investment Management Co Llc who had been investing in Harvard Bioscience Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $167.43 million market cap company. The stock increased 4.35% or $0.2 during the last trading session, reaching $4.8. About 143,731 shares traded. Harvard Bioscience, Inc. (NASDAQ:HBIO) has declined 25.93%   downtrending. It has underperformed by 42.63% the S&P500. 
Evanson Asset Management Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 17.13% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Evanson Asset Management Llc sold 27,095 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.78% with the market. The institutional investor held 131,071 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $20.20M, down from 158,166 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Evanson Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $922.05 billion market cap company.
